proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free image generations per day (renewed daily)
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides serverless, fast API access to cutting-edge models like FLUX.1 Schnell, SDXL, and specialized ControlNet pipelines without cold starts.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Can be integrated directly into 'produce_coloring_book' or 'produce_kdp_cover' workflows in GitHub Actions using standard cURL/Python requests.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Daily limit is strictly enforced. Heavy usage requires rotating keys or upgrading, but 100 images/day is perfect for bootstrapping.

proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Converts any URL (including search results, blogs, or trend pages) into clean, LLM-friendly Markdown format with a simple prefix: https://r.jina.ai/URL.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Used in 'agent_trendhunter' or 'agent_opportunity_hunter' to scrape live market trends and feed them directly to the Gemini brain without writing complex scrapers.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Some highly protected sites (Cloudflare-shielded) might block the Jina proxies, but works perfectly for 90% of open web pages.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: No monthly fee. 5% + $0.50 per transaction fee.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Acts as the Merchant of Record (MoR), meaning they handle global sales tax and EU VAT compliance automatically. Essential for Hugo who is based in France.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Distribution endpoint for digital asset packs (gamedev assets, 3D printing STL files, PDF coloring books) generated by 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' or 'produce_stl_parametric'.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Payout thresholds apply. Payouts are weekly/monthly depending on accumulation, with standard processing fees.

proposals.tool_or_platform: Kokoro TTS (via Hugging Face Gradio Spaces)
proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free open-source API calls via gradio_client Python library
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: An ultra-lightweight (82M parameters) text-to-speech model that produces human-quality voiceovers matching or exceeding ElevenLabs, entirely for free when run on hosted spaces.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Audiobook generation pipeline or promo video narration for marketing KDP/Redbubble products on social media, run directly from GitHub Actions.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Public Hugging Face Spaces can occasionally go down or experience high latency under load. A backup fallback Space is recommended.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to list models. Printables takes a 10% fee on Store sales.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Rapidly growing 3D printing community run by Prusa. Features a built-in 'Store' for digital STLs and a 'Club' subscription model. Highly active user base looking for functional designs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Publishing step for parametric/procedural STL files created by 'produce_stl_parametric', acting as a direct competitor/supplement to Cults3D.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires high-quality design presentation (renders/photos) to stand out and gain traction.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free formatting and distribution; they take 10% of the retail price per sale.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Distributes paperbacks and ebooks to a massive network of stores (Barnes & Noble, Kobo, Apple Books, Tolino) from a single upload interface.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Secondary distribution step for 'produce_coloring_book' or 'produce_lowcontent_kdp' after launching on Amazon KDP to capture non-Amazon buyers.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Formatting guidelines are strict, and changes can take a few days to propagate across all partner channels.

proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides clean JSON results for Google Searches, Google Shopping, and Google Trends without triggers, captchas, or proxy management.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Niche validation phase inside 'agent_niche_gap' or 'agent_trend_explosion' to dynamically pull actual marketplace pricing and search volume.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: 100 searches/month is low, meaning it must be called selectively (e.g., once or twice a week during a scheduled cron trend-hunt).
